text:
sai: Heads up — automated staged rollout from blue->green started at 1792004300 but traffic attenuation never completed and the pipeline kept flipping a small % back to blue. seeing increased 5xx in eu-west-1 and GPU saturation on green-pool.

deploy-bot: Deployment started: release/2026-03-18-rls-9f3a
deploy-bot: traffic-split: blue=90%, green=10% -> scheduled attenuation to 50% at t+10m then 100% at t+30m

alex: I just checked argocd: "argocd app diff inference-service" shows a diff in helm values for trafficWeight. local values.yaml vs repo are mismatched.

jen: wait — how did values.yaml diverge? We push everything through gitops.

maria: Looks like a hotfix job ran yesterday to bump memory on a GPU nodepool and updated release values directly via `helm upgrade --reuse-values` on the cluster. that overwrote repo state.

sai: that explains it. rollout automation assumes GitOps source-of-truth. because the cluster had an ad-hoc change, the attenuation controller kept reconciling to the cluster state which had trafficWeight stuck at 10.

alex: quick checks:
```
# show release values on cluster
kubectl -n inference get configmap inference-traffic -o yaml
# show repo version
git --no-pager show origin/main:charts/inference/values.yaml: | sed -n '1,60p'
argocd app history inference-service
```

jen: I grabbed logs from the progressive-delivery controller — it hit the `maxUnavailable` probe and started rollback attempts, which then triggered a webhook to the rollback controller that immediately tried to reapply the cluster-local helm values. loop.

ops-bot: ALERT: rollout_loop_detected on inference-service (count=3) — automated rollback engaged.

maria: The weird part: green pods are fine on CPU but GPU metric `sm_utilization` is 98% on the new pool because traffic weighting was supposed to be attenuated earlier, not sustained. that pushed the nodepool autoscaler to spin up extra nodes but quota in eu-west-1 prevented scale.

alex: Quota issue: `gcp: GPUs per region quota reached` — raised ticket with cloudops but we need immediate mitigation. options: reduce concurrency per replica, lower batch size, or shift a percentage of inference traffic to us-central1 fallback pool.

sai: Immediate plan: 1) pause the automated attenuation (so controller stops flipping) 2) patch Argo repo with the cluster-intended values and create a PR for audit 3) shift 20% traffic to us-central1 fallback via routing policy override 4) open quota request with cloudops.

jen: I'll pause the attenuation controller: `kubectl patch deployment progressive-controller -n platform --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/replicas","value":0}]'` — doing now

alex: I pushed the values patch to a branch and created PR #487 with description "restore trafficWeight to match cluster hotfix; add guard to prevent direct helm upgrades". Please review.

maria: Routing shift executed: `redwoodctl traffic set inference-service --region us-central1 --weight 20` — verify logs show new routing.

deploy-bot: Routing change applied: us-central1=20%, eu-west-1=80%

sai: After routing change, green GPU pool load dropped to ~70% and pod restarts stopped. autoscaler stabilized. monitoring: no further 5xx.

ops-bot: NOTE: detected terraform drift on nodepool resource `google_container_node_pool.gpu_pool` — manual patch applied on cluster (hotfix) not present in terraform state. Recommend importing resource and creating a terraform plan.

alex: Agreed — we need to import the nodepool into terraform state and then run a plan. I'll do `terraform import` then reconcile the changed memory/tolerations into IaC.

jen: Also adding an automated guard in the progressive delivery controller: verify argocd sync status before each attenuation step and fail open (stop further attenuation) if repo != cluster. putting a quick PR for that check.

maria: Can we add a small preflight that checks regional GPU quota before increasing weight? if quota low, route more to fallback automatically. saves us from the manual shift.

sai: yes — feature request for Optimize team. For now I'm going to mark this incident as mitigated. we'll close when PRs merged and terraform import done. thanks for the fast responses :thumbsup:

alex: PR #487 merged to main with audit entry. terraform import scheduled and in progress.

jen: progressive controller patch merged to staging, will roll to prod after smoke test.

deploy-bot: Incident closed by sai at 1792005899
